description: This file defines the ParserLabel class responsible for managing label language files in the SuiteCRM system, including adding, removing, and handling label data within language packs and module extensions.

classes.name: ParserLabel
classes.description: Class for handling language label files: adding, removing, and updating labels in language packs for modules within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing module and package names, and setting up the logger.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Static method to initialize the logger instance used throughout the class.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes incoming label parameters to add new labels to the language pack, for a specific module and language.

methods.name: removeLabel
methods.description: Removes a specified label from a module's language file, with optional processing for relationship labels.

methods.name: addLabels
methods.description: Adds a set of labels to a module's language files, creating or updating the relevant PHP files and clearing caches.

methods.name: handleSaveRelationshipLabels
methods.description: Handles saving of relationship-specific labels, invoking addLabels for each label definition.

methods.name: addLabelsToAllLanguages
methods.description: Adds labels to all available languages for the current module.
